items.claim: Jan Blachowicz is dealing with injuries and the effects of aging.
items.quote: Where for Yan Blahhovich, especially with the injuries, with the age, if things don't go his way, I don't see him having a plan B or C.

items.claim: Uros Medic cannot fight effectively while moving backwards on a straight line.
items.quote: Eros Medic cannot fight going backwards. You go back and look at the fight against Puna Haley Soraniano. He got backed up on a straight line and got tall...

items.claim: Uros Medic has won all of his professional fights by stoppage.
items.quote: Eros Medic has won all of his fights by stoppage.

items.claim: Uros Medic trains with Beneil Dariush, giving him good preparation for facing southpaw strikers.
items.quote: Eros Medic's main training partner is Benil Daruse... very technical southpaw striker. So for Uros Medic, that's a good ace that he's got up his sleeve is having a training partner like Benil Daruse.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez effectively utilizes his jab and uses a reset jab to punctuate combinations.
items.quote: Daniel Rodriguez's best weapon is his jab... I love the way that Drod establishes his jab and once he'll throw the cross to keep himself in balance if he doesn't want to blitz...
